title: Solana co-founder Anatoly Yakovenko is a big fan of agentic coding
description: Speaking at TechCrunch Disrupt, Yakovenko said he's become increasingly comfortable taking a back seat in software development tasks.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Box CEO Aaron Levie on how AI is changing the enterprise SaaS landscape
description: He painted a picture of a future of enterprise software where the SaaS is used for the core business workflow, and then the agents ride on top of that.
author: Sarah Perez

title: ElevenLabs CEO says AI audio models will be ‘commoditized’ over time
description: ElevenLabs' founder Mati Staniszewski said that, in the short term, AI audio models were still the "biggest advantage and the biggest step change you can have today."
author: Sarah Perez

title: How AI labs use Mercor to get the data companies won’t share
description: Mercor CEO Brendan Foody has built a $10 billion empire freeing up valuable data from legacy industries and making it available to AI labs.
author: Maxwell Zeff

title: Nvidia becomes first public company worth $5 trillion
description: With a market cap of $5 trillion, Nvidia is now worth more than the aggregated stock markets of all countries, apart from the United States, China and Japan.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2025: Day 3
description: This is the third and final day of TechCrunch Disrupt 2025 at Moscone West in San Francisco. Register here to get a 50% discount and don't miss out on innovation and scaling.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Grammarly rebrands to ‘Superhuman,’ launches a new AI assistant
description: Grammarly is renaming itself as Superhuman, after acquiring Superhuman email client in July
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Character.AI is ending its chatbot experience for kids
description: After facing lawsuits and public outcry following the suicides of two teenagers, Character.AI says it's making changes to its platform to protect children, changes that could affect the startup’s bottom line.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Phia’s founders on how AI is changing online shopping
description: Phia founders, Phoebe Gates and Sophia Kianni, are building an AI assistant that aims to help you shop, and save.
author: Sarah Perez

title: ‘Silicon Valley’ star Thomas Middleditch makes a surprise appearance at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025
description: Actor Thomas Middleditch had a planned takeover of Australian startup Othelia’s presentation at the pitch showcase stage.
author: Morgan Little

title: Mappa’s AI voice analysis helps you find the best job candidates and will show off its tech at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025
description: Mappa's AI hiring platform can assess a candidate's behavior based on voice patterns, and aims to take some of the guesswork out of hiring.
author: Maxwell Zeff

title: Inside CampusAI’s mission to close the AI training gap for everyday workers — check it out at TechCrunch Disrupt 2025
description: CampusAI is an educational platform focused on making learning accessible to everyday people who want to bring AI into their everyday workflows, and a virtual ecosystem to connect like-minded people.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Super Teacher is building an AI tutor for elementary schools — catch it at Disrupt 2025
description: Super Teacher’s app features animated tutors with AI-generated voices that guide students through interactive lessons. Students talk to the app using voice, like a conversation with a teacher.
author: Maxwell Zeff
